about: The node's checked helpful links (step 726-6). One file for every node: the main agent reads it (skill helpful-links, npm run recommend), elements ask the core's door GET /api/node/helpful-links. Edited only by the owner's word, in the core; a node update brings it everywhere.

links.name: Contabo VPS
links.for: A rented server in a data centre, so the node and its Telegram bots keep working when this computer is off.
links.verdict: The owner's partner link to Contabo's VPS plans. His recommended minimum for a node: 8 GB of memory and 4 cores; compare the plan's memory on the page before paying (the core's build peaks above 13 GiB, so the move adds swap on an 8 GB server).
